description:
## What to build

Package/toolchain classification becomes a pure function classify_entry(name, data) -> PackageInfo | ToolchainInfo, and scan_packages shrinks to a thin filesystem walk (iterdir + read + json.loads) that delegates to it. Mirrors the existing pure parse_toolchain_data seam.

Behavior-preserving: the generated docs HTML must be byte-identical before and after. This is a pure deepening, not a behavior change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] classify_entry(name, data) is pure: no filesystem access, dict in / model out
- [ ] scan_packages is a thin walk that reads each data.json and delegates classification to classify_entry
- [ ] Classification tests feed dicts directly to classify_entry and no longer build a tmp_packages tree
- [ ] A small number of thin tests still cover the scan_packages walk itself (finds data.json, skips non-dirs)
- [ ] Generated HTML output is unchanged (byte-identical) vs. before the refactor
- [ ] Existing test suite green (docs/tests)

## Blocked by

- None — can start immediately.
title: Extract pure classify_entry; make scan_packages a thin walk
